title: Fleet import in the core
goal: A whole fleet file loads in one transaction as NERV's fleet import does
acceptance: parseFleetImport (unknown fields refused) and importFleet move into src/fpv-core for drones, parts and spares: missing drones and slots created, existing drones kept, each component model gets a spares row at 0 new and 0 used unless one exists, a report of what changed
Printed-part and print-job fields stay out (see F-010's scope); a file carrying them is refused or ignored as the record decides, with a test
Tests carried over or rewritten from NERV's test/fleet-import.test.ts with an invented fleet file
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A behaviour difference from NERV's FPV pack is recorded and goes to the owner before it lands

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: about 200 lines of parse and import code; separating out the printed-part fields carries the uncertainty. Not a measurement.
